description: Sleeve everything a deck (id or name) has claimed for itself, in one call: each staged, non-shared allocation becomes sleeved and its copies physically move into the deck's location (a stack the deck holds only part of is split). Use it once the user says the deck is physically built. Borrowed copies never move: a shared allocation stays staged, and so does a copy whose stack another deck has sleeved. Returns `sleeved` and `stayed`; every `stayed` row carries its `reason`, the other decks (`also_allocated_to`) and where the card is (`physically_in`). ALWAYS tell the user which cards stayed and why, name the other decks on any `sleeved` row that lists them, and say which sleeved cards are proxies (`is_proxy`).
name: sleeve_deck
title: Sleeve deck
